label: No Pocket
description: Choosing no chest pocket leaves the shirt front completely clean and uninterrupted. The absence of a pocket is considered the dressiest and most formal option, keeping the front smooth under a tie or jacket. It gives the shirt a minimal, elegant appearance and is standard on tuxedo and most fitted dress shirts.
